# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large mixed bag of call recordings, but only a modest subset are genuine **sales/trade calls** (customer enquiries, rate negotiation, order confirmation, dealer/distributor talk). A large share of the files are: (a) pure **logistics/ops chatter** — vehicle loading, crane, driver coordination, DC/e-way bill, payment-charge disputes, cutting-machine (operator "Yuvraj") instructions; (b) **personal/unrelated calls** (Vishal's Hindi/Gujarati personal chats, wrong numbers, voicemails, cricket/market gossip) with no product content; (c) very short "send me rate/WhatsApp" stubs with no real information exchanged.

The genuine sales signal comes mainly from repeat B2B buyers (fabricators, engineering contractors, traders/dealers like "Zetwork Harish," "VR Earth Movers," "Vinayaga Steel Pradeep," "Vidveda," "SRIDHAR/Sivakesava Engineers," "Vasanth Narasimhan Engg," site engineers at construction companies, and small retail/dealer counters). Because genuine pricing/negotiation calls are relatively few and repetitive (mostly TMT and plate rate-chasing), this KB stays concise and sticks only to what is explicitly said — no invented SKUs, policies, or numbers.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what sales calls actually mention, BSC trades in:

- **TMT rebar** — grades **Fe500 / 500D / 550D**, also **E250** and **E350** mentioned for structural rod ("E250 grade-ஆ sir... E350-ன்னா உங்களுக்கு அதோட ₹3000 extra வரும்"). Brands referenced: **SAIL ("sale")**, **Vizag/RINL ("R&L")**. One call explains 550D is scarce because RINL ("R&L") had stopped producing it for 3 months, so only 500D is available via CRS: "500D எல்லாம் போய் கிடைக்காது... RNL திருப்பி production start பண்ணான்னா அவங்க வந்து கொஞ்சம் பண்ணுவாங்க."
- **Structural steel**: ISMB, ISA/angles (L-angle, square/rectangle angle), I-channel/C-channel, SHS/RHS (square & rectangular hollow sections — explicitly "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir"), flats, base plates. Sizes like 100x100x8, 90x90x8, 300x140 vs 300x150 ISMC compared for weight/flange difference.
- **MS Plates / sheets** — checkered plate and normal plate, thicknesses 2mm–45mm, sizes like 2500x6300, 4x8, 8x4; CR (cold rolled) coil/sheet to IS 513 spec also sourced for a customer (outsourced, not BSC's own product).
- **Pipes/tubes**: square tube mentioned but **not stocked** ("Square tube நம்மகிட்ட இல்லை sir").
- **Brands mentioned**: SAIL, Vaisakh, NMDC (for plates), JSW, Tata Steel (compared by customers), RINL/Vizag, Joyster (ISMB brand). One call notes Vaisakh and SAIL have no price difference, but BSC only deals SAIL for SHS-type items.
- **Grades/certs**: MTC/TC (mill test certificate) requested by B2B customers before payment; BSC's standard line is "PO/payment வரணும், இல்ல MTC தர மாட்டோம்."
- Length/cutting services: coil-cut to custom lengths (3m, 5m, 2500mm, 6300mm standard stock lengths); company generally **does not cut flats/angles to length** ("Flats-லாம் நம்ம cut பண்றது கிடையாது"), but will do special cuts case-by-case with an extra cutting charge (~₹5/ton mentioned once).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- TMT/Vizag indicative rates across calls (all **plus GST, loading, transport extra** — stated repeatedly): ₹54 (madam negotiation, later settled ₹53.50/18ft length), ₹59–61 (ISMB/steel general), ₹61.50–65.50 (sheet/CRS/plate over different weeks, clearly trending up: "59 ரூபாய் 58 ரூபாய்... இப்போ rate increase ஆயிடுச்சு"), ₹62–65 (TMT 12–32mm band), ₹65–70 (various dates, with 16–25mm quoted ₹65,000/ton and 8mm quoted ₹70,000/ton on one call), ₹69/₹68.50 for 12mm/16mm (Saveetha Institute quote), ₹63.50 Vizag rate quoted by a distributor in Vijayawada call.
- Grade premium: **E350 costs ₹3,000 more per ton than E250** on the same size.
- ISMC 300x150 vs 300x140: **₹3,000/ton cheaper** for 300x150 due to lower weight (42kg/m vs 46kg/m) and thinner flange (150 vs 140) — offered as a cost-saving alternative but customer stuck with the heavier standard spec.
- Flat cutting charge: "₹5 per ton கணக்காகும்" if a size needs custom cutting — customer preferred to avoid it and take a second vehicle instead.
- "Payment charges"/standard transport documentation fee: **₹200 standard**, one customer disputed a ₹250 charge and an $8,000-equivalent ₹8,000 transport-charge omission that was fixed via a debit note.
- Credit term mentioned explicitly: **1 month credit** available for some accounts, but rate protection is tied to advance payment, not credit ("credit-ல close ஆயிடுச்சு... advance, எனக்கு rate கரெக்டா இருந்தது").
- Minimum sample policy: **1 piece per 1 meter sample**, collected by customer at site, not delivered.
- Standard stock lengths for CRS/TMT: **12 meters** (bend/cut not normally done); sheet/plate stock lengths **2500mm and 6300mm** are the default stocked sizes — 5m is NOT stocked ("5 meter-லாம் நம்ம stock வைக்கிறது இல்ல sir... 2500, 6300 தான் வச்சிருக்கோம்").
- Grade/brand pricing: SAIL and Vaisakh have **no rate difference** on ISMB/plate.
- Payment terms general pattern: **advance payment required to "block" material and get price locked**; without full payment the rate is not blocked ("full payment இருந்தாதான் sir block பண்ண முடியும்"). PO/payment required before MTC/TC is released.

## Objection Playbook
1. **"Rate ரொம்ப ஜாஸ்தி / reduce பண்ணுங்க" (price is too high)**
   - Standard response: hold firm, cite market increase, offer only tiny concessions (₹50–₹200) or none: "இல்ல sir, இல்ல sir, பண்ண மாட்டாங்க. கரெக்டா இருக்கு rate."
   - When repeat/loyal customer pushes hard, rep may quietly drop ₹500–₹1,000 per ton after "checking with management," framed as an exception: "Madam 5.5-க்கு... 535 எடுத்துக்கங்க sir final."
2. **"Why did you suddenly add a new charge (loading/payment/transport)?"**
   - Rep apologizes, offers a debit/credit note to reconcile rather than reversing the invoice: "அதை நான் debit note raise பண்ணிடுறேன்."
   - If customer threatens to escalate to MD, rep stays calm, reiterates standard process, avoids confrontation.
3. **"Competitor/other supplier gives it cheaper"**
   - Rep points to genuine cost drivers (weight difference, flange thickness, grade, production scarcity of 500D) rather than just matching price: "weight கம்மியா இருக்கு... அதுக்காக சொல்கிறேன்."
   - Distributor-to-distributor calls show reps acknowledging competitor rates and trying to match/beat by small margins ("63.5 try பண்ணி செஞ்சு எடுத்து").
4. **Stock unavailability (size/length/brand not in stock)**
   - Transparent about what's missing, offers nearest available alternative: "Square tube நம்மகிட்ட இல்லை sir," "5 mm 2350 size-ல இருக்காது... 6300-ல இருக்கு."
   - Avoids over-promising delivery dates when coil-cutting is pending ("3M coil cut பண்ணி தான் கொடுக்கணும்").
5. **MTC/TC / documentation demands without payment**
   - Firm boundary: "PO வரணும். இல்ல MTC தர மாட்டோம்." No test certificate issued before commercial commitment.
6. **Payment-proof disputes (missing vehicle photo/slip)**
   - Rep acknowledges system/camera issues honestly rather than denying, offers to reissue signed/sealed payment copy: "print எடுத்து வேணா seal போட்டு sign போட்டு கொடுக்கட்டுமா?"
7. **Delay in loading/dispatch**
   - Rep gives conditional timelines tied to payment and cutting status ("Monday தான் பண்ண முடியும்... program machine free-யா இருந்தா பண்ணி கொடுத்துருவோம்").

## Effective Lines (openings, discovery, closing, follow-up)
**Openings**
- "Sir சொல்லுங்க Sir" / "Hello, Hello சொல்லுங்க" — simple, fast pickup framing that lets the caller state need immediately.
- Caller self-identifies company clearly upfront for trust: "நான் Sangeetha Traders-ல இருந்து பேசுறேன்," "VR Atmos-ல இருந்து Murugan பேசுறேன்."

**Discovery**
- Always nails down **item, size, thickness, quantity, grade, delivery location** before quoting: "என்ன item quantity breakup அனுப்புங்க," "என்ன size வேணும் sir?", "delivery location எங்க sir?"
- Confirms brand/grade explicitly to avoid mismatches: "இது E250 grade-ஆ sir?", "sale TMT 500D தான் வருமா sir CRS-ல?"
- Cl
